div.head: Ine 67
div.ab: CXI. Gif mon gyrde londes geþingeð oþþe mare to rædegafole ⁊ ereð, gif se hlaford him wile ðæt lond aræran to weorce ⁊ to gafole, ne þearf he him onfon gif he him nan botl ne slihð, ⁊ þolige his æcera.

CXI. Gif mon geþingað gyrde landes oþþe mare to rædegafole ⁊ geereð, gif se hlaford him wile þæt land aræran to weorce ⁊ to gafole, ne þearf he him onfón, gif he him nan botl ne selð, ⁊ þolie þara æcra.

Si quis componat pro uirgata terre uel amplius ad gablum et arabit, si dominus uelit ei terram illam ponere ad gablum et opus, non necesse est hoc excipi, si nulla domus commissa sit ei, sed perdat ipsas acras.

{CXI} Gif mon geþingað gyrde landes oþþe mare to rædegafole ⁊ geereð: gif se hlaford him wile þæt land aræran to weorc ⁊ to gefole, ne þearf he him onfón gif he him nan botl ne selð; ⁊ þolie þara æcra.

If someone takes on a fourth part of a hide or more at fixed rent and ploughs it: if the lord [later] wishes to raise the land [in terms of value] in regard to work and to rent, he need not accept this if he [the lord] does not give him a dwelling, and he [the lord] must forfeit the crops.

If a man takes a yard of land or more, at a fixed rent, and ploughs it, [and] if the lord requires service as well as rent, he [the tenant] need not take the land if the lord does not give him a dwelling ; but [in that case] he [the tenant] must forfeit the crops .

Wenn jemand eine Gerte Landes oder mehr auf Vertragsabgabe pachtet und beackert, [später jedoch] der [Grund]herr ihm das Land auf Frondienst, ausser auf Pachtzins, steigern will, so braucht der [Bauer] es nicht anzunehmen, wenn jener [Herr] ihm nicht [auch] eine Hofstätte giebt, und entbehre der Äcker.

If someone leases a yardland or more at a fixed rent and ploughs it, [but later] the [land]lord wishes to raise the land [to require] labour-service as well as rent, then the [peasant] need not accept it, if that [lord] does not [also] give him a dwelling, and let him forgo the fields.
